description_en: Changes the billing method of an ApsaraDB RDS instance
description_zh: 该接口用于变更RDS实例的计费方式
kebab_example: aliyun rds transform-db-instance-pay-type --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --pay-type Prepaid --region cn-hangzhou
name: TransformDBInstancePayType

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the ID of the instance
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration of the instance. Valid values:

If you set Period to Year, the value of UsedTime ranges from 1 to 5.
If you set Period to Month, the value of UsedTime ranges from 1 to 11.

This parameter must be specified when PayType is set to Prepaid
parameters.help_zh:
指定购买时长。取值：
当参数Period为Year时，UsedTime取值为1~5。
当参数Period为Month时，UsedTime取值为1~11。

若PayType=Prepaid，需要传入该参数
parameters.name: used_time

parameters.help_en:
The new billing method of the instance. Valid values:

Postpaid: pay-as-you-go
Prepaid: subscription
parameters.help_zh:
实例变更后的付费类型。取值：
Postpaid：后付费（按量付费）
Prepaid：预付费（包年包月）
parameters.name: pay_type

parameters.help_en:
The renewal cycle of the instance. Valid values:

Year
Month

This parameter must be specified if you set PayType to Prepaid
parameters.help_zh:
指定预付费实例为包年或者包月类型。取值：
Year：包年
Month：包月

若PayType=Prepaid，需要传入该参数
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en: The additional business information about the instance
parameters.name: business_info

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the auto-renewal feature for the instance. Valid values:

true
false

This parameter is valid only when you change the billing method from pay-as-you-go to subscription.
All strings except true are considered false
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启自动续费。取值：

true：开启
false：关闭

该参数仅在按量付费转包年包月时生效。
传入的所有非true字符串均会被处理为false
parameters.name: auto_renew

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use vouchers to offset fees. Valid values:

true
false (default)
parameters.help_zh:
是否使用代金券抵扣费用，取值：

true：使用
false：不使用（默认值）
parameters.name: auto_use_coupon

ChargeType.description_en:
The payment type.

Valid value if the new billing method is pay-as-you-go: POSTPAY
Valid value if the new billing method is subscription: PREPAY
ChargeType.description_zh:
付费类型。
按量付费：POSTPAY
包年包月：PREPAY

ExpiredTime.description_en:
The expiration time.

If you call this operation to change the billing method of an instance from subscription to pay-as-you-go, this parameter is not returned
ExpiredTime.description_zh:
到期时间。
如果变更为按量付费，该参数不返回
